prompts.title: Set Up a Self-Improving Quality Gate for a Go Repository
prompts.description: Once per Go repository, when the code is already built and you want an automated gate that blocks sloppy, AI-generated Go code and gets stricter over time.
prompts.author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 Medium

prompts.title: Optimize CI Speed Without Weakening Checks
prompts.description: Once per repository, when CI feedback is too slow — audit where pipeline time goes and restructure it toward sub-minute PR results without hiding or dropping any check.
prompts.author: Pontus Abrahamsson (@pontusab)

prompts.title: Untangle Codebase
prompts.description: Once per codebase, when it has grown tangled — a one-pass structural refactor so a typical change lands in one place and agents working in it break less.
prompts.author: Maze (@mazeincoding)

prompts.title: Prune Tests That Guard No Behavior
prompts.description: Once per codebase, when the test suite has grown bloated — delete or rewrite every test that guards no behavior so each remaining test fails on a regression and only on a regression.
prompts.author: Maze (@mazeincoding)

prompts.title: Optimize Web Font Loading Without Changing Rendering
prompts.description: Once per site, when web fonts are slowing page loads — subset, split and preload fonts to shrink font bytes as far as possible while keeping rendering pixel-identical.
prompts.author: Shu (@shuding)

prompts.title: Audit and Fix a Site's SEO and AI-Search (GEO) Readiness
prompts.description: Once per site, when you want every public page brought into compliance with Google's SEO guidance plus AI-search readiness — route inventory, per-page 9-point audit, prioritized fixes, and verified SEO/GEO scores.
prompts.author: Dan Kornas (@DanKornas)

prompts.title: Audit Authorization and Data Isolation
prompts.description: Once per application, before giving real customers access — audit the codebase for broken access controls, privilege escalation and cross-tenant data exposure that a login system alone does not prevent.
prompts.author: Sujay (@Sujay__Raj)

prompts.title: Unslop an App Before Sharing
prompts.description: Once per app, before you share it — a polish pass over the screens and flows recent work touched: responsive widths, every state, slop removal, accessibility, and a grouped fix report.
prompts.author: Coffee with One (@coffeewithone)

prompts.title: Audit Design System Consistency
prompts.description: Once per application, when buttons, cards and spacing have drifted into visual inconsistency — audit design tokens, shared components and component states, then produce a prioritized consistency and refactoring plan.
prompts.author: Sujay (@Sujay__Raj)

prompts.title: Deslop a Rust Codebase's Structure
prompts.description: Once per Rust codebase, when its module structure has grown sloppy — run the deslop-please linter and fix every flagged error from first principles toward deep modules and narrow interfaces.
prompts.author: Xiangpeng Hao (@MOVNTDQ)

prompts.title: Unslop AI-Generated UI Design
prompts.description: Once per application, when AI-generated screens carry the tell-tale AI look — inventory the tells, codify a binding DESIGN_RULES.md with semantic tokens and motion budgets, fix every violation, and verify with screenshots.
prompts.author: Elia Kuratli (@eliakuratli)

prompts.title: Audit and Refactor UI Design
prompts.description: Once per application, when the UI works but looks off — a diagnostic pass that sweeps seven lenses in fixed causal order (hierarchy to finishing touches), reports severity-ranked findings that each cite a rule, then fixes violations and re-verifies with screenshots.
prompts.author: edisonmbli

prompts.title: Build a Fast Client-Rendered React App
prompts.description: Once per project, when starting a new client-rendered React app — scaffold it on a pinned Vite/Rolldown/TanStack stack with TanStack Redact as the default renderer, intent-based loading, hard byte budgets in CI, and a measured renderer release decision.
prompts.author: Pontus Abrahamsson (@pontusab)
